name: PLEIAD 22

real.trim: 22B STi Version, 2-door coupe, 5MT, limited to 400 units (JDM)

specs.notes: EJ22G: 280 PS (276 hp) at 6,000 rpm, 363 N m at 3,200; 1,270 kg; centre diff ~36:64 (driver-adjustable DCCD); 5-speed 3.083/2.062/1.545/1.151/0.825, final 4.444 (the Japanese catalogue: 3.416 is reverse). Power, torque, weight, wheelbase and the DCCD come from STI's official page. Gear ratios, reverse and final drive come from the goo-net catalogue spec sheet. Several English sites (supercars.net, monkeymotor) list the final drive as 3.416, but 3.416 is the reverse ratio; the catalogue final drive is

garage.blurb: The widebody homologation special: a 2.2 turbo flat-four, wide arches, gold wheels and four-wheel drive that drags you out of every hairpin. Only 400 were made.

interior.notes: Complete, textured: seats, dash, steering wheel, gear lever and handbrake (both work). Right-hand drive.
